rows.predecessor_quote: The defining Product, requirement, Goals, or accepted-design authority records: exact method and project basis; known evaluation inventory; each frame declaration and capability envelope; ...
rows.successor_quote: the explanation of the allocation, with its material resource limits and failure assumptions, that ACTIVATION §1 Configuration requires of every configuration
rows.what_changed: A tenth required record item is added: the allocation explanation with material resource limits and failure assumptions. A configuration record complete under rc.2's nine items is incomplete under the successor.
rows.counterexample: An accepted-design record defines a project frame configuration with the nine rc.2 items and no allocation explanation. rc.2: the configuration is lawfully recorded. Successor: the record lacks a required item.
